hooks.command: count=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..main 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [ "$count" -gt 0 ] && jq -nc --arg c "$count" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("This branch is " + $c + " commit(s) behind main. Before making changes, run `git merge main` in the worktree; before proposing a merge into main, merge main in, re-run the affected packages tests and typechecks, then rebase onto main so the merge fast-forwards.")}}'; true
